verdict.rationale: Credentials and secrets are stored on the YubiKey's secure element rather than with a vendor (yubikey-docs-7, yubikey-docs-23), so the user holds that data. The official ykman CLI offers scriptable management of PIV, OATH and OTP slots (yubikey-probe-rt-1), which implies the user can clear stored credentials, but the evidence never explicitly describes deleting or resetting them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of credential deletion or factory reset, any vendor data-retention or deletion policy (including for YubiEnterprise service data), and independent corroboration of deletion workflows.
